comment.body: Thanks for including the screenshot of the OneNote plugin load message. It establishes what appears at startup, but the report is from PowerToys 0.99.1 and does not show whether the current plugin fails during discovery or OneNote-specific initialization. If this still occurs on the latest stable build, please reproduce it and add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward so the packaged startup logs can distinguish those paths. If Settings and the tray cannot open, run `BugReportTool.exe` from the PowerToys installation directory instead.
